definition.function: The SenseAgri AI platform captures house signals, runs inference on-site, and sends actions to a dashboard and WhatsApp.
definition.differentiator: The environmental sensor suite of the SenseAgri AI platform is live on farms today; other capabilities are validated in pilots on each operation.

sections.heading: What does the SenseAgri AI platform monitor?
paragraphs: The SenseAgri AI platform continuously monitors house conditions: temperature, humidity, gas, CO₂, feed, water, egg count and more, around the clock. [1]

Published SenseAgri AI platform pages also list ammonia, vision-based egg counting for layers and breeders, broiler bird tracking, acoustic welfare signals, feed-to-water ratio, hen-day production, mortality trends, and feed conversion. [2]

stats.text: temperature, humidity, gas, CO₂, feed, water, egg count

sections.heading: Where does the SenseAgri AI platform run inference?
paragraphs: Sensing and inference on the SenseAgri AI platform run on-site, so the SenseAgri AI platform keeps working through patchy connectivity. Data from the SenseAgri AI platform syncs to the cloud the moment the link returns. [1]

Vision inference on the SenseAgri AI platform runs on the farm's own edge compute, with no cloud round-trip per frame. Cameras on the SenseAgri AI platform integrate with the CCTV the farm already uses. [1]

sections.heading: Which equipment does the SenseAgri AI platform integrate with?
paragraphs: The SenseAgri AI platform integrates with major poultry platforms already on the farm: Big Dutchman, SKOV, Hytek, Vencomatic and more. [1]

Farms keep the controllers they have; the SenseAgri AI platform adds continuous monitoring and causal analysis on top. Alerts from the SenseAgri AI platform arrive on WhatsApp with the specific action to take. [1]

sections.heading: What is not production-ready on the SenseAgri AI platform?
paragraphs: SenseAgri AI states that the sensor suite of the SenseAgri AI platform, environmental monitoring, air quality, and climate alerts, is live and running on farms today. [2]

The SenseAgri AI platform does not count vision, acoustic, or gut-health capabilities as production-ready on a given farm until they are proven on that farm's own houses. Pilots are how SenseAgri AI validates each of those capabilities. [2]
